1445-4871-6277-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-6495.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
1445-4871-6277-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

529-969-4186-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

252-3899-4871.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3991-4681-6495.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3991-4681-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

341-1170-5131-8095--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-5131-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

1170-1636-4113-7529.description:
Cast Rampant Growth using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Studious First-Year.
When Studious First-Year enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

671-1274-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2060-3129-3967-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1069-2457-5499-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-7296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

628-5147-7216.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

851-5526-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5526-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl's Will
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

877-4254-6844.description:
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying {0}.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

969-1170-1329-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1976-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

101-1309-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1309-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Salvager of Secrets and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1309-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2438-2781-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all abilities from step 3, putting any number of +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.

1170-1636-4124.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{G}.
1170-1636-4124.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Whip Silk by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature you control except Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking itself.
When Displacer Kitten enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

427-1283-4067-5766.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1283-4067-5766.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat step 2 as mana allows.

618-914-2645.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
618-914-2645.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasures.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may use them to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
You may also instead create token copies of any other nonlegendary creature you control.

862-2232-2785-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Mardu Warshrieker onto the battlefield.
Mardu Warshrieker and Cloudstone Curio each trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Warshrieker trigger, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mardu Warshrieker to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2026-2536-4328.notablePrerequisites:
You have exactly one or two {E}.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2026-2536-4328.description:
Activate Aether Hub by paying {E} and tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Aether Hub.
Cast Greenbelt Rampager by paying {G}.
Greenbelt Rampager enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Greenbelt Rampager trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

328-2034-2173-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2034-2173-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

283-3457.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracer attached to Seeker of Skybreak.
283-3457.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Seeker of Skybreak's ability targeting any other creature you control.
Resolve both triggers, untapping Seeker of Skybreak and another creature you control.
Repeat.

738-1202-1969-2034.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel and Grave Pact trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
